interfaces.summary: PersistenceCoordinator/write-behind/preparations removed; handle-based session storage contract added.
SessionHandle (read/append/flush/close, AsyncDisposable) and SessionAccess 'read'|'write' become the single open-channel abstraction.
SessionPersistenceCreateOptions/OpenOptions/ListOptions/StatOptions added; resume is now an explicit open with access mode.
Cross-process kernel write lease: SessionWriteLease via flock(2) on session.lock (POSIX) / named semaphore (Windows); SessionAlreadyOwnedError.
Native session format catalog with adjacent migrations v0->v1->v2->v3; SessionFormatUnsupportedError and sessionFormatVersionRefusal fail closed on unknown versions instead of corrupting.
Agent loop gains assistant-stream and inbox type surfaces plus system-prompt commit/decision inputs.
Agent exposes Inbox/InboxState/InboxWireState and AssistantStreamFrame; inbox.d.ts relocated.
SubagentRuntime gains startContinuable/sendMessage/listChildren/listDescendants/interruptByParent/prompt; descriptor-seed removed.
ContinuableActivationRegistry + Activation: durable continuable child with process-local residency epochs, serialized delivery, settlement and cold resume.
Continuable child identity is the durable SessionId with recorded direct parentSession; lineage authorization rejects stale parents.
dsh-subagent-fork-in-process public .d.ts unchanged; session fork prefix is now explicit via SessionHandle.inheritedEventCount / header.isSeeded.
Agent SubagentInbox admission/close surface and Inbox state vocabulary added; queueSubagentPrompt removed.
Session event vocabulary validation added (validateSessionEventData, validateSurfaceMetadata); BYQ observe() event-type allowlist must be re-probed against the 0.1.5 event catalog.
Canonical integer event seq is retained (SessionHandle.read offset/seq; seq-ranges).
evidence: SessionHandleReadResult.events SessionEvent[]; read(offset,length); seq-ranges.d.ts present in both

interfaces.summary: No public .d.ts/symbol change in dsh-compaction between 0.1.2-rc.1 and 0.1.5-rc.2.
No public .d.ts/symbol change in dsh-spill.

BYQ sdk profile invocation patch only references pre-existing plugin ids, but new upstream packages (dsh-agent-presets, dsh-persona, dsh-plan-mode, dsh-message-feedback) change the composition surface and require a live probe.
evidence: bundled closure added set; BYQ profile patch references agent-loop, session-title-llm, tool-* ids

interfaces.summary: Cordis closure gains cordis-plugin-hmr and cordis-plugin-logger-console in the bundled runtime; provider registration order/identity must be re-verified.
Python SDK package files are byte-identical; deepseek_harness_runtime still exposes bundled_runtime_path with the same naming. Bundled executable content changed (npm 0.1.2-rc.1 -> 0.1.5-rc.1).
evidence: wheel file diff identical for all deepseek_harness/*.py; runtime-bin 0.1.5rc1 bundles npm 0.1.5-rc.1

interfaces.summary: dsh-terminal/dsh-terminal-bash public .d.ts unchanged, but 0.1.5 bundles dsh-tool-terminal, dsh-tool-bash-persistent, dsh-tool-pwsh-persistent and dsh-tmux-context; owner-scoped persistent PTY becomes a first-class capability.
evidence: dsh-terminal identical .d.ts; bundled closure added dsh-tool-present; dsh-terminal present in both bundles

interfaces.summary: dsh-jobs, dsh-jobs-local, dsh-tools public .d.ts unchanged; BYQ keeps tool-jobs disabled in the product profile.

dsh-llm-pi-ai adds thinking token budget catalog fields (PiAiThinkingTokenBudgetField, THINKING_TOKEN_BUDGET_FIELDS); dsh-llm adds SystemMessage/FileBlock/SystemPromptUpdate. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash route must be re-qualified with the new budget vocabulary.
Provider/model catalogue and credentials surfaces change indirectly via dsh-llm-pi-ai thinking-budget and new credential/model packages; BYQ credential reference boundary must be re-probed keyless.
evidence: dsh-llm-pi-ai symbol additions; bundled closure additions

interfaces.summary: dsh-sdk-jsonrpc-server and dsh-app-boot public surfaces show no .d.ts/symbol change in the sampled diff; lifecycle timing still requires a live start probe.
dsh-subprocess public .d.ts unchanged; BYQ's one-process-per-root-turn and one-per-session modes depend on runtime.py, not the subprocess package API.
Durability is now only promised by SessionHandle.flush(); append is best-effort and write-behind was removed. Crash-survival of session logs depends on an explicit flush barrier.
evidence: handle.d.ts flush() docs: 'the only operation that promises storage'; -write-behind.d.ts
